title: Only Basic Remote Mining trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1822177 (0x001bcde1), HLP file offset 461782 (0x00070bd6), topic 278 'Only Basic Remote Mining'
provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Only Basic Remote Mining; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #150 resource at file offset 0x2fab00, candidate control 300 (caption empty; position-based lead only); no literal 'Only Basic Remote Mining' ASCII string was found in the executable by exact-byte search
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Only Basic Remote Mining and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Only Basic Remote Mining changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: The Robo-Miner, Robo-Maxi-Miner and Robo-Super-Miner robots and the Maxi-Miner hull are unavailable (documented-only).

unresolved: The complete hull and robot exclusion set is not decoded.
The help title implies a population bonus, but no population-bonus text was decoded; do not implement one without evidence.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
